intent: tpunit fixture verifying that GetJob/GetJobs commands whose response can't be delivered (scheduled via commandExecuteTime) requeue their job(s) instead of losing them, and that the job(s) can be re-fetched afterward.

objects.name: FailedJobReplyTest
objects.role: single test looping over {GetJob, GetJobs} x {with/without retryAfter}

objects.name: FailedJobReplyTest::failSendingResponse
objects.role: creates job(s), forces an undeliverable fetch, confirms re-fetchability

name_fit.note: Describes exactly what it tests: replies that fail to send.

location_fit.note: Grouped with other per-command Jobs plugin tests.

naming_quality.note: The comment above failSendingResponse ("// Cannot cancel a job with children") is copy-pasted from CancelJobTest and describes the wrong behavior.
